items.stem: Why use a tagging scheme like BIO for NER rather than a single label per token?

options.text: It marks entity boundaries, distinguishing the start and continuation of multi-token entities
options.rationale: Correct: BIO encodes spans so adjacent entities are separable.
Speed is not the purpose of BIO.

options.text: It removes the need for a model
options.rationale: A model still predicts the tags.
It is a labelling scheme, not an accuracy guarantee.
